steps.name: Kali's Trust (1)
steps.objective: After talking to [Media] in "Kali", obtain the items <Tam's Magic Stone>, <Powerful Brainwashing Magic Stone>, and <Disillusionment Stone> and deliver them to [Media] in "Kali".

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: You are here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I came because you told me to visit often if I want to be trusted.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes, I definitely said that. What story should we tell? You should also talk about what you want.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Iris The power needed for the goddess to become the complete master of the world... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I need to receive a trace of Mediah's power for Iris. Because superhuman strength helps Iris... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Isn't it strange that my power, even though I'm just a human being, can help a goddess? The power of humans and the power of God are different.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: The goddess who received that power shows different abilities... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now that I think about it, it seems like something is a little strange. Even if Iris receives superhuman strength through me... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Superhumans are also human, and I am also human… , Iris is in the realm of God. Ugh, it's complicated.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: There must have been a lot of questionable parts, but you don't have any of those things about Goddess Iris.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It's a subtle but enviable relationship. So shall we get to the point?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Please bring me the magic stone.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … What kind of magic stone do you need?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Ultimately, it is a magic stone created with the power obtained by the Deimos Church by hunting down our clan.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: You won't be able to get it unless you go to Avalon. And even if I go, I don't know where it is... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I'm just guessing that they don't have much magic stones left. Looking at the increase in the number of times the church invades Adrica... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So you hid the village. To protect… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Because we have lived like that for a long time. So, through magic stones, we try to find out what they are obsessed with.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: So, I would like you to bring it from the place where there were traces of the magic stone. The required magic stones are ‘Tam’s Magic Stone’, ‘Powerful Brainwashing Magic Stone’, and ‘Disillusionment Stone’.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Magic stones discovered in Gendia, Freios, and Eastland... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I'll get it for you right away. So... . Once this is over, will I be able to earn Mediah’s trust?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Let's think more positively than before.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, since you need it, I will get it for you. I also need to look for any other clues. Then let’s go.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes, I hope everything goes well.

steps.name: Kali's Trust (2)
steps.objective: Go to [Layer] in the “Underground City of Tartarus.”

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: You are here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: As you said, I found the magic stone. here… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Would you like to wait here for a moment?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Since you might be bored while you wait, I'll give you some tea.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It smells good. Can you tell me the name of this tea?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: There is a tree called Daphne that only grows on the land of welcome, and its leaves are used to make tea. It is also the name of a former leader who was like my mother.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I remember her as a great person, but someone's remaining memories say she was a witch who enjoyed Walpurgis Night... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: We even end up talking about this. Pretend you didn't hear it. Really, you are a strange person... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Oh, just wait a moment.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will. But it’s Walpurgis Night… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Pandora told me not to get involved in this...)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: The magic stone you saved me... . It wasn't difficult to figure out the features.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: One of the three, the one found in the Superhuman Memorial Hall, appears to have been made by the Deimos Church. Even a little bit, the life force of the Kali clan was in there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What on earth is the Deimos Church trying to do? .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: We've been looking for what they do for over 200 years, but no one has figured it out.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Now let’s talk about the other two magic stones. There are definitely traces of those called Agashura... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why is that? Is there any problem?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It is apparently an imitation of the Deimos Church's magic stone. The skill is there, but it's not enough to keep up with the original.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Shinik said that Van and Mara were fake Agashura. Does that have anything to do with it?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I haven't seen much of the Agashura clan, so it would be difficult to say.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I can't believe they made such a mess of Zendia and Freios when they were counterfeit products... . So, the Deimos Church's magic stones are more dangerous... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: … That's all of my story. Thank you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I feel like I know something more, but I’m cutting it off here….)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: And I was grateful for the book that Layer requested. Because I was able to understand, even briefly, how the goddess felt.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You've read that book. Oh, but who brought it to you?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Tartarus wanted to exchange things and sent us a lot of goods. Baynon asked me to send it back, but I couldn't refuse so I decided to take it for now.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: If you're on your way back, please say hello to Layer for his hard work. I'm fine, I chose the right layer... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: And please tell Noel too.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It can be dangerous because of the Deimos Church, so don't go anywhere other than Tartarus, where Luman and Shinik are located, where Giscard is located... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will tell you everything. See you later then.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: (Maybe you should come one more time...)

steps.name: Kali's Trust (3)
steps.objective: Go to [Noel] in the “Underground City of Tartarus.”

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: You look tired, honey. You must be very busy. Where are you coming from?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm coming from Cali.

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: Huh… .

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: (Layer seems shocked and cannot continue speaking.)

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: That's right. He wasn't an ordinary person. Seeing that he is looking for the hard-to-find village 'Kali', he seems like the person chosen by the goddess.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Medea already asked me to say hello to Layer.

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: What did you say?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: He said he was fine and that the layer choice was right.

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: Ahahaha. As expected, you are Medea.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But what is choice?

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: It's a very shameful past. Hmm… .

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: 30 years ago, before I met Medea, I had tremendous anger. If I can't kill everyone, I want to kill just one person... .

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: So, after finishing work, I was returning to Jude Kingdom, and as I said last time, I ended up going to Kali.

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: Well, thanks to Medea, I changed my mind during the short time I spent there.

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: I won't tell you who he wanted to kill, so don't dig any further. Ahahaha.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will.

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: (As soon as Layer finishes speaking, he takes out a carrot from the storage room and starts shaking it.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There, layer. Why are you shaking the carrot all of a sudden?

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: … Huh, I got caught. Should I talk about this or not?

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: Hey, I don't know. If anyone talks about going to Cali, Noel quietly waves a carrot and tells them to tell them. I guess something needed to be prepared.

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: I had to shake it so it wouldn't be noticeable, but I guess it was too visible. Ahahaha.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … That's right, it looked really good. Medea already has a story to tell to Noel.

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: That's good. Noel will be waiting too. Oh, I'll take a shot next time, so look forward to it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, great!! Please let me know when the time comes. Then I'll go to Noel.

steps.name: Kali's Trust (4)
steps.objective: Obtain <Dwarven Artisan's Bolts and Nuts> and <Dwarven Artisan's Utility Toolbox> from "Dwarven Airship". And 'Go to [Merimel] in "Cali".

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: (Noel must be embarrassed and quickly averts his gaze.)

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: Oh, that's right. Awesome Adventurer! Please buy me just one item.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Did you see the carrots well?

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: It's a carrot!

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: Oh no!! I was selling stuff!

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: Phew… , that's right. If you ever hear a story from someone who has been to Cali, I asked them to wave a carrot at me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But why carrots? There's something else too.

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: It is said that in Eastland, for a long time, carrots were always waved when secretly carrying out work or checking carefully.

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: So Adventurer has been to Cali, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, that's right. There was also a message from Medea.

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: Are you Medea?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Mediah tells the story she told for Noel.)

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: Hehe, as expected, Medea has a lot to worry about. I'm still doing that.

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: Adventurer, could you do me a favor? Adventurer will be able to do it because you can find Kali and go in right away.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What does that mean? It sounds like Noel can't enter the village... .

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: The village is protected by the power of Medea. No matter how Kali you are, once you leave, you won't be able to find them easily. I also found out after I left.

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: I can't find the village again... . Moreover, it is dangerous in the Land of Illusion... . At least it is visible to a special person like Adventurer... .

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: Still, it's a good thing. The Deimos Church did not properly recognize it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I know what you mean. So how can I help you?

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: I have a friend who I grew up with since I was little, Callie Merrymel. I'm very dexterous, so I'm good at making things.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, Merrymel! i know. They worked hard to make things.

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: It's still the same. Hehehe. Merrymel also wanted to create a city like Shinik of Tartarus, so he also admired her. I shouldn't follow that personality... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Shh. There are visions of Shinik wandering around here and there, and if you talk about it... .

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: Shinik says this isn't fun, so it's okay. Anyway, Merrymel has been making a machine for a long time, but they haven't finished it yet.

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: I looked into what I needed, and it turned out that dwarven craftsman bolts and nuts would do. All you have to do is get it and bring it to me... .

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: Plus, as long as you have the dwarven craftsman's all-purpose toolbox, there's nothing that Merrymel can't make!! That child is different from me, he is full of talent.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So, you are telling me to get the ingredients and bring them to Merrymel.

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: Yes! that's right! If you just bring the ingredients to Merrymel!! I will take you as a VIP of Noel Company, which will be the target of Tartarus in the future.

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: For the Kali people, trust is life.

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: This is an item that can be obtained in cities where a race called dwarves live. I don't have the courage to go there yet. Could you please come instead of me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay. Then I'll come back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (For the Kali people, trust is life... Uh, I think the spirits also used the word trust last time...)

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: You're here again.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I know very well that outsiders are not welcome. Still, I did the favor and brought what Merrymel needed.

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: If you please... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Give Merrymel the dwarven craftsman’s bolts and nuts and an all-purpose tool box.)

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: Huh, this is… .

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: Noel asked for it.

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: (Merimel begins to cry.)

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: Noel, Noel... . Ahhhhh.

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: People like Beynon only bring us useless things... .

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: (Baynon, who is in the distance, is sighing while looking at Merrymel.)

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: I miss Noel, but he left town and never came back... . The bad thing is, I was in a lot of trouble... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Noel said that once you leave, even if you are a Kali, you won't be able to easily find the location of the village.

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: Ah… … .

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: So, after Noel left town, he never came back. I thought Noel just walked away without thinking about me... . I didn't even know that.

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: (Merimel’s eyes look sad.)

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: However, Baynon quickly left and came back to deal with the Deimos Church's hunters.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: Well, Beynon is a little different from the villagers. Since I was young, various things have happened… .

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: Thanks to this, I think we will be able to create machines that can protect the village. Medea said she was worried about me and told me not to overdo it... .

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: I will work hard to create things within the scope of my ability. For the village people!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (People here care about each other tremendously.)

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: Adventurer seems to already be trusted by Noel. Noel isn't the type of kid who asks anyone for something like that... .

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: There was something I wanted to say just now, but I lost it. I'll let you know next time I think of it.

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: Thank you, Adventurer. Now I think I can trust Adventurer.

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: If you need help later, please let me know. I will help you as much as I can.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Merrymel. Then I'll go.

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: Yes, bye then.

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: (Merimel looks at the items she received at Noel’s request and sobs.)

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: Sorry, Noel... .

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: And I love you… .
